capabilities: Generate exam-style quiz questions from a note, selection, multiple notes, or folder
Grade short answers with an AI model and explain correct answers
Save wrong answers as automatic error notes in a per-subject Errors folder
Re-quiz errors with new wording until a streak of correct answers archives them
Track every answer in local history and produce per-subject stats
extras: Works with free OpenRouter models within rate limits (20 requests/min, 50/day). Warning in README not to quiz notes containing private data, since note text is sent to OpenRouter, and the API key is stored unencrypted in data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to test yourself on note content, so certification and exam candidates must write practice questions elsewhere.

relations.evidence: Questions come from an OpenRouter model (free ones work).

summary: AI-powered quiz generator that turns your notes into exam-style practice questions and re-quizzes your mistakes until they are mastered.
